products.title: Linux Command-Line Essentials
products.summary: Use a clean Linux terminal to navigate a filesystem, manage files, inspect text, understand permissions and complete practical command-line tasks.
objectives: Navigate a Linux filesystem safely
Create, inspect and organise files and directories
Use basic text and search commands
Recognise least-privilege file permission concepts

products.title: Bits, Bytes & Binary Fundamentals
products.summary: Build a practical mental model of digital data with binary switches, bit-to-byte conversion challenges, data-rate examples and a short knowledge check.
objectives: Explain the relationship between bits and bytes
Read an eight-bit binary value
Convert bits to bytes and bytes to bits
Distinguish data-rate and storage-unit notation

products.title: IPv4 Subnetting Foundations
products.summary: Turn IPv4 bits, CIDR masks and /26 subnet boundaries into practical network calculations with a visual subnetting lab.
objectives: Explain why IPv4 addresses use 32 bits and four octets
Interpret subnet-mask 1s as network bits and 0s as host bits
Relate /24 through /30 to decimal and binary subnet masks
Calculate total and ordinary usable hosts
Identify /26 network, host and broadcast boundaries

products.title: REMnux Triage & Memory Forensics
products.summary: Use a harmless simulated investigation to practise analysis boundaries, static triage, evidence provenance and memory-forensics correlation.
objectives: Establish an authorised and isolated analysis boundary
Record a reproducible static-triage baseline
Treat artefacts as leads that require corroboration
Correlate process, socket and timeline records from a memory-forensics view

products.title: FLARE VM Analysis Workbench
products.summary: Learn the safe Windows reverse-engineering workbench lifecycle: managed VM, snapshot, evidence provenance, telemetry correlation and reset.
objectives: Explain the disposable-VM and snapshot model
Capture static PE-style evidence with provenance
Read pre-recorded process, filesystem and network telemetry as a timeline
Reset an analysis session to known-good state

products.title: Kali Linux Evidence & Network Forensics
products.summary: Practise a read-only evidence workflow, disk-image triage and offline PCAP reasoning without live scanning or target interaction.
objectives: Preserve authority, integrity and read-only handling boundaries
Record hash, partition and file-inventory observations
Analyse a stored PCAP offline and preserve the filter used
Distinguish forensic examination from live enumeration
